text: Part one. Everyone says you need an authentic brand story. They're wrong. The belief is that if your why is real and vulnerable and true to you, people will buy. So founders spend months worshiping their origin story, staring at their own life trying to make it sound meaningful enough. But here's what actually moves customers. They buy the outcome they want, the identity they want to be seen with, and the proof that you can deliver. Your story is just the frame you hang that proof on. So flip it.
